subject: New versions of RSQLite and DBI break sqldf

messages.author: 17e30776ec2a7fb1
messages.subject: New versions of RSQLite and DBI break sqldf
parts:
New versions of DBI and RSQLite have been released which break sqldf. 

Until sqldf is updated please revert to the DBI 0.3.1 and RSQLite 0.11.4. 

An easy way to revert is to use the checkpoint package as shown here: 
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/26571232/sqldf-not-working-after-update

messages.author: 17e30776ec2a7fb1
messages.subject: Re: New versions of RSQLite and DBI break sqldf
parts:
A new version of sqldf, version 0.4-9, has been uploaded to CRAN and should 
be available shortly.  It addresses the incompatibility introduced with RSQLite 1.0.0.
